basic_info.description: Stunning, rebuilt Noe Valley masterpiece with resort-style indoor/outdoor living on a tree-lined block just two blocks from the J-Church MUNI and Church Street's cafs and shops. This 4,200+ sq ft, down-to-the-studs build features 6 bedrooms, 5 full and 2 half baths across 4 levels. Highlights include a dramatic open main level with Thermo Ayous African wood, a 10' Calacatta marble island, SubZero/Wolf appliances, and floor-to-ceiling glass framing hillside views. The upper level offers 3 beds and 3 full baths, including a serene primary suite with Ipe view deck and a Calacatta-clad bath with soaking tub. A chic garden lounge with wet bar opens to a sun-drenched deck; ​an expansive lower level great room features a rec/media space with kitchenette, bedroom suite, home office, ​half BA and sliding glass wall to an Ipe deck and lush, level ​south facing yard. The backyard oasis includes an outdoor kitchen, gas fire pit hookup, and mature landscaping. ​New foundation, radiant heat, A​/C, built in Sonos, and all-new systems throughout. Walk to ​N​oe Rec for tennis, basketball, and playground. Close to shops + restaurants at both Church St and 24th St villages, MUNI & tech shuttles.​ Mins to 101/280. You CAN have it all!
